note: Every dependency edge that pointed the wrong way when semantic checking was switched on. It is a record, not a permission: tools/verify-dependency-graph.php fails on any edge not listed here, fails when a listed edge no longer exists so the entry has to be deleted, and fails when an entry passes its expiry. The baseline therefore only ever shrinks, and phase 3 empties it — its exit gate is that this tooling reports zero unapproved or expired violations.
